question.text: What will India's total meat production per capita be during 2026-2027?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the total meat production per capita of India during 2026-27 as reported by [the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying](https://www.dahd.gov.in/) of the Government of India.

research:
India's meat production per capita for 2026-27 has not been published, and the question cannot be settled yet. The most recent official figure is 7.50 to 7.51 kg/annum for 2024-25. The 2025-26 figure should come out around 26 Nov 2026, and the 2026-27 figure around late Nov 2027.

## 1. Resolution source
- The figure comes from the Ministry's annual Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics (BAHS) report, Integrated Sample Survey division. The 2026-27 value will most likely appear in BAHS 2027, expected around late November 2027. [DAHD AHS page](https://dahd.gov.in/schemes/programmes/animal-husbandry-statistics)
- 2025-11-26: BAHS 2025 came out on National Milk Day. Its brochure gives per capita meat as 7.39 kg (2023-24) and 7.51 kg (2024-25), a 1.62% rise. Production was 10.25 million tonnes (Mt) and then 10.50 Mt, up 2.46%. [Brochure](https://dahd.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-11/BAHS2025Brochure.pdf), [agridots](https://agridots.com/courses/exam-ibps-afo/agriculture/animal-husbandry/01-03-production-parameters)
- 2026-02: The full BAHS 2025 report says 7.50 kg for 2024-25, so the brochure and full report differ by 0.01 kg. The DAHD pages returned 403 errors, so I could not open them directly. [Full report](https://dahd.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-02/BAHS2025.pdf), [Vet Extension](https://www.vetextension.com/livestock-production-statistics-of-india-2025/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The 2026-27 financial year runs from April 2026 to March 2027, and its estimate will only be released around late Nov 2027.
- I found no 2025-26 figure yet. BAHS 2026 is probably due around 2026-11-26, following the release pattern of 2024-11-26 and 2025-11-26, but I found no official announcement of the date. [affairscloud](https://affairscloud.com/dahd-released-basic-animal-husbandry-statistics-2025/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-11: News reports say rice prices are rising because of weak rainfall and El Niño. Higher feed and grain costs could matter for poultry. [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/rice-prices-rise-amid-lower-expected-production-inadequate-rainfall-reduced-fertilizer-use-101794380073538.html)
- 2026-11-10: About 60% of ethanol offered to oil companies is maize-based, which raises concern that maize, the main poultry feed grain, is being diverted. [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/60-of-the-ethanol-offered-to-omcs-this-year-is-maizebased-101794251609081.html)
- 2026 (date not given): ICRA expects poultry earnings to improve in FY27 as broiler prices recover. Producers had cut broiler placements in the first half of FY26 because of oversupply. [Outlook Business](https://www.outlookbusiness.com/news/icra-sees-poultry-earnings-improving-as-broiler-prices-recover-in-fy27)
- 2026-04 to 2026-07: Bird flu hit Maharashtra's Navapur hub again, with a restricted zone from 3 May to 31 July. [Jaano Junction](https://www.jaanojunction.com/news/this-time-we-dont-have-strength-to-rebuild-bird-flu-hits-western-indias-biggest-egg-supply-hub-again)
- 2026-01: India reported 11 H5N1 outbreaks on farms in Kerala. [The Poultry Site](https://www.thepoultrysite.com/news/2026/01/india-reports-11-h5n1-outbreaks-on-poultry-farms)
- 2025: The USDA's New Delhi office forecast carabeef (buffalo meat) output at 4.7 million tonnes carcass weight in calendar 2026, up from 4.6 in 2025. [USDA FAS](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Livestock+and+Products+Annual_New+Delhi_India_IN2025-0048.pdf)

## 4. Base rates
Official per capita meat figures (kg/annum):
- 2014-15: 5.32. [Economic Survey](https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/economicsurvey/ebook_es2022/files/basic-html/page277.html)
- 2018-19: 6.15 (BAHS 2025)
- 2019-20: 6.45; 2020-21: 6.52 (provisional). [DAHD](https://dahd.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-10/MlpGrowthRate202223.pdf)
- 2021-22: 6.82 (PTI report)
- 2022-23: 7.10. [Pashudhan Praharee](https://pashudhanpraharee.com/?p=31279), [Statista](https://statista.com/statistics/1357130/india-meat-availability-per-capita)
- 2023-24: 7.39
- 2024-25: 7.50/7.51

Trend:
- Year-on-year gains were +0.30, +0.07 (the COVID year), +0.30, +0.28, +0.29 and +0.11/+0.12. The average from 2018-19 to 2024-25 is about +0.23 kg/yr.
- Production growth slowed from 4.95% in 2023-24 to 2.46% in 2024-25. [The Week/PTI](https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/business/2024/11/26/dcm98-biz-agri-meat.html)
- Since 2014-15 the series has fallen in no year, though the gain was small in 2020-21.
- Simple arithmetic, not a forecast: adding the last gain (about 0.11) twice to 7.50 gives about 7.72 for 2026-27. Using the six-year average (about 0.23) gives about 7.96.
- Seasonality does not matter here: the figure is a single annual financial-year number, published every November.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no prediction market or expert forecast on this question.
- The Kalshi and Polymarket markets supplied are about US or Indian corporate and political topics. None of them matches this question.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-11-26: BAHS 2026 with the 2025-26 figure, before forecasts close. This is the key update.
- Possible mid-2027 data: parliamentary answers and the Economic Survey (around Jan-Feb 2027) may repeat 2025-26 numbers. No 2026-27 figure is expected before forecasts close on 2027-06-30.
- Risks to 2026-27 output: bird flu outbreaks, feed costs from maize diversion to ethanol and a weak monsoon or El Niño, and the broiler price cycle.
- Population figure: per capita availability is total production divided by the population figure DAHD uses, and the source of that figure is my assumption, not something I confirmed. Census 2027, with reference date 1 March 2027, could eventually change that figure. Whether it affects BAHS 2027 is unclear, and I found no evidence either way.
- About 2027-11-26: BAHS 2027 is expected to report the 2026-27 value that resolves the question.

Sources: [DAHD AHS](https://dahd.gov.in/schemes/programmes/animal-husbandry-statistics), [BAHS2025 Brochure](https://dahd.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-11/BAHS2025Brochure.pdf), [BAHS2025](https://dahd.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-02/BAHS2025.pdf), [agridots](https://agridots.com/courses/exam-ibps-afo/agriculture/animal-husbandry/01-03-production-parameters), [Vet Extension](https://www.vetextension.com/livestock-production-statistics-of-india-2025/), [DAHD growth table](https://dahd.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-10/MlpGrowthRate202223.pdf), [Economic Survey](https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/economicsurvey/ebook_es2022/files/basic-html/page277.html), [Pashudhan Praharee](https://pashudhanpraharee.com/?p=31279), [Statista](https://statista.com/statistics/1357130/india-meat-availability-per-capita), [The Week](https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/business/2024/11/26/dcm98-biz-agri-meat.html), [affairscloud](https://affairscloud.com/dahd-released-basic-animal-husbandry-statistics-2025/), [Outlook Business](https://www.outlookbusiness.com/news/icra-sees-poultry-earnings-improving-as-broiler-prices-recover-in-fy27), [Poultry Site](https://www.thepoultrysite.com/news/2026/01/india-reports-11-h5n1-outbreaks-on-poultry-farms), [Jaano Junction](https://www.jaanojunction.com/news/this-time-we-dont-have-strength-to-rebuild-bird-flu-hits-western-indias-biggest-egg-supply-hub-again), [USDA FAS](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Livestock+and+Products+Annual_New+Delhi_India_IN2025-0048.pdf), [HT rice](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/rice-prices-rise-amid-lower-expected-production-inadequate-rainfall-reduced-fertilizer-use-101794380073538.html), [HT ethanol](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/60-of-the-ethanol-offered-to-omcs-this-year-is-maizebased-101794251609081.html)

# India meat production per capita, 2026-27: research notes

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding figure will be DAHD's "per capita availability of meat" for 2026-27. It should appear in Basic Animal Husbandry Statistics (BAHS) 2027, which on past timing would be released around National Milk Day (26 November 2027). That is very close to the 2027-11-30 resolution date, so a slip in publication is a real risk. BAHS 2024 came out 2024-11-26 and BAHS 2023 on 2023-11-30. [DAHD AHS page](https://dahd.gov.in/schemes/programmes/animal-husbandry-statistics)
- I could not open the DAHD site, the BAHS PDFs or the PIB pages directly (all returned HTTP 403). The figures below come from search snippets and secondary write-ups.
- 2025-11-26: BAHS 2025 was released by MoS S.P. Singh Baghel. It gave 10.50 MT of meat in 2024-25 (+2.46%) and per capita availability of 7.50 kg/annum. The survey year runs March to February. [PIB](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2195049&reg=3&lang=2); [Vet Extension](https://www.vetextension.com/livestock-production-statistics-of-india-2025/)
- One summary gives 7.51 kg instead of 7.50 kg. [Agridots](https://agridots.com/courses/exam-ibps-afo/agriculture/animal-husbandry/01-03-production-parameters)
- The full BAHS 2025 PDF was posted in February 2026, after the November press release. [DAHD](https://dahd.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-02/BAHS2025.pdf)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing is settled. The 2026-27 survey year (about March 2026 to February 2027) is still under way.
- BAHS 2026, which should give the 2025-26 figure, has not been released yet. On past timing it is due around 2026-11-26. I found no announcement.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-11: Rice prices are rising on a weak 2026-27 crop outlook, poor rainfall and El Niño. That is relevant to feed and grain costs. [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/rice-prices-rise-amid-lower-expected-production-inadequate-rainfall-reduced-fertilizer-use-101794380073538.html)
- 2026-11-10: Maize-based ethanol makes up about 60% of the 19.32 bn litres offered to oil companies. That could take about 30 MT of maize and tighten poultry feed supply. [Hindustan Times](https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/60-of-the-ethanol-offered-to-omcs-this-year-is-maizebased-101794251609081.html)
- 2026-06 (around 10 June): Poultry industry members agreed to cut day-old chick production by 25% and cull parent breeder stock after soybean meal prices rose more than 40%. Poultry is about half of India's meat (about 5.18 MT in 2024-25). [aviNews](https://avinews.com/en/indian-poultry-industry-to-cut-production-by-25-amid-soybean-meal-price-surge/); [Pashu Sandesh](https://pashusandesh.com/Indian-Poultry-Industry-Orders-25-perct-Cut-in-Day-Old-Chick-Production); [PL Raj IAS](https://plrajiasacademy.com/pdf/current-affairs/20251204-6931114cc556e.pdf)
- 2026: CRISIL expects broiler volume growth of 2-4% in FY27 and revenue growth of about 10%, driven by higher prices from short supply. ICRA sees broiler prices recovering in FY27. [Rural Voice](https://eng.ruralvoice.in/poultry-industry-to-return-to-double-digit-growth-in-fy27-as-higher-egg-and-broiler-prices-boost-revenue-crisil); [Outlook Business](https://www.outlookbusiness.com/news/icra-sees-poultry-earnings-improving-as-broiler-prices-recover-in-fy27)
- 2026 (semi-annual report): USDA FAS raised its India bovine meat forecast for calendar 2026 to 4.73 MMT carcass weight equivalent, from 4.68 MMT in 2025. This series is not comparable with DAHD's. [USDA GAIN](https://apps.fas.usda.gov/newgainapi/api/Report/DownloadReportByFileName?fileName=Livestock+and+Products+Semi-annual_New+Delhi_India_IN2026-0009.pdf)

## 4. Base rates
Per capita availability (kg/annum), from DAHD as reported by secondary sources:

| Year | kg/annum | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 2018-19 | 6.15 | |
| 2019-20 | 6.45 | |
| 2020-21 | 6.52 | provisional |
| 2021-22 | 6.82 | |
| 2022-23 | 7.10 | |
| 2023-24 | about 7.39 | not confirmed; implied by 10.25 MT and the trend |
| 2024-25 | 7.50 | |

Sources: [srpublication](https://www.srpublication.com/?p=7269); [NABARD](https://www.nabard.org/auth/writereaddata/tender/2501230332composition-and-pattern-of-livestock.pdf); [Pashudhan Praharee](https://pashudhanpraharee.com/?p=31279); [Statista](https://statista.com/statistics/1357130/india-meat-availability-per-capita)

- **Year-on-year changes:** +0.30, +0.07, +0.30, +0.28, about +0.29, then about +0.11 kg. Average about +0.22 kg a year, with a range of +0.07 to +0.30. The 2024-25 gain was the second smallest.
- **Production growth:** +4.95% in 2023-24 and +2.46% in 2024-25.
- **Implied population:** 10.50 MT / 7.50 kg gives about 1.40 bn people. Population growth is about 0.8-0.9% a year, so per capita growth runs roughly 0.9 points below production growth.
- **Simple arithmetic, not a forecast:** two more years at the historical range of gains (+0.07 to +0.30 kg a year) would put 2026-27 at about 7.64-8.10 kg.
- **Revisions:** DAHD revises figures. The 2020-21 number was provisional, and BAHS 2026 may restate 2024-25.
- **Seasonality:** this is an annual figure built from summer, rainy and winter survey seasons, so intra-year seasonal comparisons do not apply.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on Indian meat output. None of the markets supplied with this request match the question (they cover US and Arkansas production, Indian politics and similar topics).
- I found no official or expert forecast of India's per capita meat availability for 2026-27.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Around 2026-11-26: BAHS 2026 release with the 2025-26 figure. This is the key anchor and may revise 2024-25.
- Early 2027: USDA FAS annual and semi-annual India livestock reports.
- Through February 2027: feed costs (maize diverted to ethanol, soymeal), the poultry supply cuts from June 2026, El Niño and the weak monsoon hitting grain, and any bird flu outbreaks.
- Around 2027-11-26: BAHS 2027 with the 2026-27 figure. It could miss the resolution date if it is delayed.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** The 2026-27 figure should appear in BAHS 2027, around late November 2027, about 12.5 months from now. Forecasts close on 2027-06-30. The 2025-26 figure is due around 2026-11-26 and will be a useful update.

(b) **Latest known value:** 7.50 kg per capita for 2024-25 (full BAHS 2025 report, February 2026). The November 2025 brochure gave 7.51.

(c) **If nothing changed:** about 7.50 kg.

(d) **If the current trend continued:**
- At the latest pace (production +2.46% a year, population about +0.85%), per capita rises about 1.6% a year. That gives about 7.74 for 2026-27.
- At the six-year average gain of about 0.23 kg a year, it gives about 7.96.
- A blend of the two, with a modest poultry recovery in FY27 (ICRA), suggests a median around 7.8.

(e) **Historical variation:** Two-year changes since 2018-19 range from about +0.37 kg (through the COVID year) to about +0.6 kg. The series has never fallen. Single-year gains have ranged from +0.07 to +0.30 kg.

(f) **Experts and markets:**
- No market or expert forecast exists on this exact quantity.
- USDA projects modest carabeef growth, from 4.6 to 4.7 Mt.
- ICRA expects broiler prices to recover in FY27.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** A widespread H5N1 outbreak, combined with feed cost spikes from maize diverted to ethanol and a weak monsoon, cuts broiler placements. Production stalls near 10.6 to 10.7 Mt, or the methodology or population figure is revised, leaving per capita near 7.4 to 7.5.
- **High:** Poultry rebounds strongly after the FY26 cutbacks, and production grows 5% or more a year. A downward revision of the population figure, possibly informed by early Census 2027 results, could push per capita to 8.2 to 8.4.

(b) **Latest known value:** 7.50 kg/annum for 2024-25, from the full BAHS 2025 report (Feb 2026). The brochure (2025-11-26) gives 7.51. Production was 10.50 Mt, up 2.46%.

(c) **If nothing changed:** about 7.50 kg.

(d) **If the trend continued:**
- Production has grown 2.5-5% a year and population about 0.9% a year, so per capita has grown about 1.6-4% a year.
- Two years of that gives roughly 7.74 to 8.11.
- Recent momentum is slower: the last gain was +0.11 after several gains near +0.29.
- FY26 broiler placement cuts and bird flu point toward a slower 2025-26. ICRA expects a poultry recovery in FY27.
- My central estimate is about 7.82-7.85.

(e) **Historical variation:**
- Two-year changes have ranged from +0.37 (COVID period) to about +0.6. The most recent two-year change was +0.40 (7.10 to 7.50).
- The series has not fallen since 2014-15.
- Methodology changes could cause a break, for example new multipliers from the 21st Livestock Census or updated population estimates.

(f) **Experts and markets:**
- There is no direct forecast or market on this question.
- USDA projects carabeef up about 2% in 2026.
- ICRA expects a poultry recovery in FY27.
- Feed cost pressure (maize diverted to ethanol, weak monsoon) is a headwind.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** Severe, widespread H5N1 culling plus a feed-price spike sharply cut poultry output. Or the 21st Livestock Census drives downward revisions, or a higher population denominator is used. Either could leave the figure flat or near 7.4-7.5.
- **High:** A strong poultry rebound plus upward revisions from new census-based multipliers push production growth above 5% a year. That would give about 8.2-8.4.
